plaque: Old oaks that move one step every night. The paths follow them. The maps do not, which is why maps are cheap here and guides are not.
tracks: Deep furrows in the moss, a stride apart. They lead to a stump with boots still standing beside it.
guide: Guide Tamsin: The oaks walk one step a night. Never stand in front of one at dusk. Never stand behind one at dawn.
Tamsin: My last client wanted to see one move. He did. Briefly.
